Apaga cuando aún brillen y parezcan poco: Turn it off while they still look glossy and underdone: they carry on setting on the plate. Pepper.
Turn it off while they still look glossy and underdone. Serve on the toasted rye bread.
Apaga el fuego y añade el atún desmigado: Turn off the heat and add the flaked tuna, folding gently so it does not turn to dust.
APAGA EL FUEGO. Espera un minuto a que l: TURN OFF THE HEAT. Wait a minute for the pan to come off the boil, then stir in two heaped tablespoons of plain yoghurt. Yoghurt splits and goes lumpy if it boils; off the heat it makes a creamy sauce.
Apaga y añade el atún de lata escurrido,: Turn it off and add the drained tinned tuna, without stirring much so it does not turn to dust.
Apaga y añade las sardinas de lata escur: Turn it off and gently add the drained, flaked tinned sardines.
Apaga y añade las sardinas desmigadas, c: Turn it off and gently add the flaked sardines. Pepper, lemon and raw oil.
APÁGALO Y SÁCALO CUANDO TODAVÍA PAREZCA: TURN IT OFF AND TAKE IT OUT WHILE IT STILL LOOKS A LITTLE RUNNY: it finishes setting from its own heat on the plate. Serve with the toast.
Aparta a un lado. Echa las gambas cocida: Push it to one side. Tip the cooked prawns into the gap, 45 seconds just to warm through. Overcooked = rubber.
Aparta del fuego, añade una cucharadita: Take it off the heat, add a teaspoon of flour and stir; go back on the heat with half a glass of hot water, swirling the PAN in circles (not stirring with a spoon) until it comes together into a thin sauce. It is a matter of persistence.
Aparta del fuego, pásalo a un bol y deja: Take it off the heat, tip it into a bowl and let it stand for a minute: it thickens a little more as it cools.
Aparta la carne a un lado, echa las verd: Push the meat to one side, tip the frozen vegetables into the gap and fry them for 4 minutes over a high heat.
Aparta la sartén del fuego. Calienta el: Take the pan off the heat. Warm the rice separately, in the microwave or with a splash of water in a covered pan for 1 minute.
Aparta las verduras a un lado de la sart: Push the vegetables to one side of the pan and cook the turkey in the gap, 3 minutes a side.
Aparta los pimientos a un lado, echa el: Push the peppers to one side, tip the turkey into the gap and cook it for 4 minutes until the pink is gone. Turkey is lean: the moment it is done, out.
Aplasta las yemas con un tenedor y mézcl: Mash the yolks with a fork and mix them with the drained tuna and a teaspoon of oil until it holds its shape. Fill the whites with that paste.
Aplástalo directamente sobre el pan tost: Mash it straight onto the toast with the fork and salt it. Mashing it in a separate bowl is one more thing to wash for nothing.
Aquí la avena va CRUDA, no cocida: absor: Here the oats go in RAW, not cooked: they soak up the moisture from the skyr and soften on their own.
Asa 25 minutos. El lomo es magrísimo y p: Roast for 25 minutes. Loin is extremely lean and overcooking leaves it dry and mealy, so err on the short side.
Asa 25 minutos. Entero y no en filetes:: Roast for 25 minutes. Whole, not in steaks: in one piece it keeps its juices.
Asa 25 minutos. Está cuando al pincharlo: Roast for 25 minutes. It is done when piercing it releases clear juice; a pale pink in the middle is right.
Asa 35 minutos. El muslo perdona mucho m: Roast for 35 minutes. Thigh is far more forgiving than breast: undercooking it is worse than overcooking.
Bacalao salado = ya desalado (24-36 h, 3: Salt cod = already desalted (24-36 h, 3 changes of water). Fresh or unsalted, straight in.
Salt cod = already desalted (24-36 h). Fresh or unsalted, straight in.
Bacalao seco, fuego medio con una cuchar: Cod patted dry, medium heat with a tablespoon of oil, skin down 4 minutes + 2 minutes. Flaking = done.
Bacalao seco, fuego medio, piel abajo 4: Cod patted dry, medium heat, skin down 4 minutes + 2 minutes. Gently, or it goes stringy. Flaking = done.
Cod patted dry, medium heat, skin down 4 minutes + 2 minutes. Gently. Flaking = done.
Bacalao seco, sartén a fuego medio con u: Cod patted dry, pan over a medium heat with a tablespoon of oil, skin down 4 minutes + 2 minutes. Flaking = done.
Baja a fuego BAJO, echa los huevos batid: Turn the heat DOWN LOW, pour in the eggs beaten with salt and wait 20 seconds without touching them.
Baja a fuego medio y añade el maíz escur: Turn the heat down to medium and add the drained sweetcorn, frying for 2 minutes.
Baja a fuego medio y FRÍE EL CURRY EN EL: Turn the heat down to medium and FRY THE CURRY IN THE OIL for 30 seconds before adding any liquid. This is the step everyone skips: raw, curry tastes of powder, and frying it releases the aroma.
Baja a fuego medio y fríe la pasta o el: Turn the heat down to medium and fry the tikka masala paste or powder for 30 seconds in the oil before adding any liquid. Without that step it tastes of raw spice.
Baja a fuego medio. Exprime el zumo de u: Turn the heat down to medium. Squeeze the juice of an orange into the pan, with a teaspoon of honey if you like. ADD THE JUICE AT THE END, NOT AT THE START: it contains sugar, and over a high heat or for too long it burns and turns bitter.
Baja el fuego a medio-bajo, echa las cla: Turn the heat down to medium-low, pour in the whites beaten with a pinch of salt and stir slowly, drawing the set edge into the middle.
Turn the heat down to medium-low, pour the whites over the spinach and stir slowly with the spatula, drawing the set edge towards the middle.
Baja el fuego a medio, añade las alubias: Turn the heat down to medium, add the beans and two tablespoons of water, and warm for 2 minutes by shaking the pan rather than stirring with a spoon.
BAJA EL FUEGO AL MÍNIMO y solo entonces: TURN THE HEAT RIGHT DOWN and only then brush the salmon with a tablespoon of teriyaki sauce, 30 seconds a side so it clings and glazes. Add the sauce at the start or over a high heat and the sugar burns black and bitter.
Baja el fuego al mínimo, añade medio vas: Turn the heat right down, add half a glass of water, cover and leave for 35 minutes. Halfway through, if it has dried out, add a little more water.
BAJA EL FUEGO ANTES DE ECHAR LA SALSA. E: TURN THE HEAT DOWN BEFORE ADDING THE SAUCE. Teriyaki contains sugar and over a high heat it burns within seconds, leaving a bitterness you cannot get rid of.
Baja el fuego y déjalos 2 minutos más: e: Turn the heat down and give them 2 minutes more: lean pork needs to cook through without burning outside.
Baja el fuego, casca los huevos dentro y: Turn the heat down, crack the eggs in and leave them for 3 minutes: they poach in the soup. Serve straight away.
Baja el fuego, echa el tomate en dados y: Turn the heat down, add the diced tomato and give it 5 minutes until it becomes a thick sauce, crushing it as it goes.
Baja el fuego, echa las claras con un pe: Turn the heat down, pour in the whites with a pinch of salt and stir slowly.
Baja el fuego, tapa la sartén y deja 4 m: Turn the heat down, put a lid on the pan and leave it for 4 minutes.
Turn the heat down, cover and leave for 4 minutes.
Bate el huevo aparte en un bol, muy bien: Beat the egg separately in a bowl, really well beaten.

Bate las claras con una pizca de sal. Cu: Beat the whites with a pinch of salt. They set faster and rubberier than whole egg, so medium heat, not high.
Beat the whites with a pinch of salt. They set faster and rubberier than whole egg: medium heat, not high.

Bate los huevos con sal y cuájalos a fue: Beat the eggs with salt and set them over a medium-low heat, stirring slowly.

Bate los huevos con una pizca de sal. Co: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Cut the cooked ham into strips.

Bébelo recién hecho: reposado, la avena: Drink it freshly made: left to stand, the oats keep absorbing and it turns into a pudding.
Bien hecho no sabe a huevo: queda como u: Done properly it does not taste of egg: it comes out like custard. If you see white threads, the egg went in too hot.
